column4: bad. The binding partition map for the split of tests/blocked-resolver-test.sh into seven tests/br-*-test.sh suites. Counts taken from the monolith at blob b898b5fd6f97080ea92f6e973b6da913a1a30f42 (origin/main, 42c0c7c) BEFORE a line moved, by the section counter tests/br-suite-partition.bh-1196-test.sh carries (a section is a `# <id>. ` line immediately after a `# =====` rule; `ok`/`bad` are counted as command words only). Totals: ok=180 bad=392. The monolith's SECOND "9." section (its line 1983, THE REBUILD'S OWN OUTCOME) is carried here as 11., the number it takes in its new file — two sections cannot share an id. This map is edited by a person when a section legitimately changes count, never regenerated by a build. Edited 2026-09-22 for BH-1460 review round 1: section 10. of tests/br-contested-test.sh gains ONE assertion, bad 49 -> 50 (totals bad 391 -> 392). br_close_pr's caller pin used to count to two; the ABANDON word gives the resolver a third close path (br_hold_abandon), so the pin now also names the enclosing function of every call. The new opener's `ok` rides on a backslash-continued line, which the command-word counter does not match, exactly like the pin it sits beside — hence bad moves and ok does not. Nothing was removed. Edited 2026-09-28 for BH-2674 (review of #2872 at 0477c3a0): section 3. of tests/br-rebuild-test.sh gains ONE assertion, bad 2 -> 3 (totals bad 392 -> 393). The ssh clear of the box's blocked stamp became a D1 `commented` row flipped to `cleared`, so the section now also pins the negative that the hub does NOT ssh to the box. Nothing was removed. Edited 2026-10-26 for BH-8430: BH-7804 (50447c18) moved section 4. of tests/br-neighbors-test.sh from the iron-law-accepted-<sha> file to the ironlaw-head-accept row; 3 openers out, 4 in, ok 4 -> 5 and bad 4 -> 5 (totals ok 181 -> 182, bad 394 -> 395; the "Totals:" figure above predates later edits). Nothing was removed from the BH-1196 partition.
